description: Defines a sealed class 'PageBreakFormatInfo' in the MigraDoc.Rendering namespace, representing formatting information for a page break with several overriding properties indicating its state.

classes.name: PageBreakFormatInfo
classes.description: A sealed class inheriting from FormatInfo, providing specific formatting details for a page break.

methods.name: EndingIsComplete
methods.description: Property indicating if the ending of the page break is complete, always true.

methods.name: IsComplete
methods.description: Property indicating if the formatting info is complete, always true.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Property indicating if the formatting info is empty, always false.

methods.name: IsEnding
methods.description: Property indicating if the element is an ending, always true.

methods.name: IsStarting
methods.description: Property indicating if the element is starting, always true.

methods.name: StartingIsComplete
methods.description: Property indicating if the starting is complete, always true.
